title: Keto Chicken Fritters
description: A low-carb twist on traditional fritters, made with chicken and Japanese-inspired ingredients.
instructions: 1. Preheat a deep frying pan with coconut oil over medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine chicken, coconut flour, ginger, soy sauce, cilantro, and scallions.
3. Mix well with your hands until everything is fully incorporated.
4. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
5. Once the oil is hot, add a few patties to the pan (do not overcrowd).
6. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
8. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
